reviews.title: Greasy
reviews.text: Arrived at counter . I checked in online ... but when checking at counter they told I didn't....... had to pay 27 dollars to check at the count because i didnt check in online... complete bs . Than the plane has mechanical issues flight was canceled. At 2030. Don't put anyone up in hotels or givw meals vouchers.... As I sit in hotel writing this at 130am I get email saying sorry here's new flight for 3pm next day.... also hotel and meal vouchers. Perfect!! As money sucking airline of course they don't send these out right away and make people pay out pocket for hotels than 5 hours later send vouchers .......rip offs I saw this coming even ... save ur time and pay a little more with air Canada or west jet because flair gets your money or time (or both) one way or another.
reviews.author: Woweee

reviews.title: A wonderful discount airline
reviews.text: You get what you pay for. No nonsense, no frills, and no problems getting us from point A to point B. We had a delayed flight once and was quickly compensated.
reviews.author: Mike A

reviews.title: Very different experiences
reviews.text: Be aware, that this is an airline that pretty much requires everything by yourself and there is almost no actual customer service. Now this wouldn't be a huge issue, the flights are very inexpensive for a reason; BUT: Their App and Website are very poorly optimized. I was unable to access my reservation several times. To the actual flying experience: our initial flight from Victoria to Calgary was delayed, which is something that was out of their hands, but I would have preferred to have more updates on the nature of the delay. The return flight was on time with no issues. The plane's interior is very plain and legroom is limited. I'm 6ft tall and I wouldn't really recommend very long flights to people around that size.
reviews.author: Edgar H

reviews.title: Ignore all the bad reviews!
reviews.text: I strongly advise booking with Flair Airlines. Despite what the reviews here may lead you to believe, I had a completely smooth and pleasant experience. No delays, no cancellations, no issues. Very comfortable and spacious seats, and an attentive staff. For a short flight duration (YVR to LAX), it is absolutely perfect and very reasonably priced. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Audrey G

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: The flight was on time, great service. Staff was very kind. Me and my daughter had a great flight due to the wonderful staff. Thank You
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.title: Easiest travel experience in a long time
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this airline. Online check in was easy, boarding was efficient, flights were on time and crew was pleasant. Love the direct flights and will book with them again
reviews.author: Kimm

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: They charged me $83 incl tax for one suitcase. Each way. Would of been cheaper to not book through them. Thule are not discount. They just hide the costs.
reviews.author: Peter B

reviews.title: Flair air sucks
reviews.text: Flight attendants were fighting each other infront of the passengers, extremely unprofessional. They then we’re going to make everyone get off the plane and said “we did this to ourselves.” Horrible service! Blonde attendant should find another job!
reviews.author: Taylor M

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: Booked multiple flight to travel between Calgary and Saskatoon. They first changed the flights time to a 12 hour difference, when I called they said I did not qualify for a refund. I then sent multiple emails and was told I would get a refund, it's been 2 months and I have still not received any refund. Since then, they have completely cancelled all their flights between the 2 cities and I have still not received any sort of refund. Terribel customer service.
reviews.author: Nicole R

reviews.title: Half the price of competition
reviews.text: I don't know why people expect 5 star service from a discount price model. If you want more, go to air Canada for twice the price but I doubt the service is any better there.
reviews.author: David N

reviews.title: Worst flight to travel with.
reviews.text: Flair will destroy your day! I boarded this flight for the 1st time and encountered lots of disappointment. 1. Flight canceled 2. Paid extra 158 cad for bags for the round trips (same bag for free at westjet airline). 3. Seat charged upon booking 4. Family separation from each other upon boarding. 5. Rude flight attendant threatened to send me out of the flight for simple expression of why separating families from each other. Almost every families in the flight were searching for each other after taking off. What a hello?! I will never board Flair in my life and will never recommend Flair airline to anyone. Not cheap with bag/loungage fees. More expensive than Westjet. Stop the joke!.
reviews.author: AyoYet

reviews.title: No service after flight cancellation
reviews.text: Flair cancelled the afternoon flight we were on and put us on the night flight. That created cost for us: hotel already booked. And deprived us of a night sleep. Our car rental ended at the time of the originalflight. Changing that was horribly expensive. Airline staff was not willing to take our luggage before official start of drop off. They could not care less that this made us hang around at the airport for nothing. Even this small service was too much. Avoid Flair: zero service airline
reviews.author: Marc J

reviews.title: Disrespectful staff
reviews.text: You get why you pay for, no public service training whatsoever, no management. No knowledge of acceptable ID. Embarassing.
reviews.author: Shelby S

reviews.title: Never prefer cheaper airline. Flights are cancelled
reviews.text: Do not fly by flair they will cancel your flight runtime. Very bad experience had to cancel my business meeting
reviews.author: vidya patil

reviews.title: Terrible service.  Impossible to deal with.
reviews.text: Needed to change the birthdate on a reservation. According to the flair website, this is free. Call the flair reservation number to make the change and they demand 400 dollars to issue a new ticket. Then hang up on me. Call back, ask why it’s 400 dollars when the website lists a new flight for only 28 dollars, and am told now it’s 800 dollars or I won’t be allowed to board. After reading off the applicable section of the tariff, the agent asks for all of my booking information to be sent to a gmail account (not Flair?), and after asking why there isn’t at least an official flair email address, the agent hangs up again. I could of course change the birthdate myself using the online system, but it’s down (not pulling up the page where you can edit things yourself). First and last time flying Flair.
reviews.author: 2MexicoAddicts

reviews.title: Nothing wrong with them….had NO issues
reviews.text: No stop in To when Vancouver to London bound: amazing. Lots of seats so u could move around! I have a voucher with AC but once I use it- will likely only fly Flair
reviews.author: Mary H

reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service
reviews.text: So far they have the best customer service. Be it for booking, or cancelling or making any changes to the flight. I might have different review for their other areas but customer service is excellent. All the time.
reviews.author: Abhi M

reviews.title: Local airlines
reviews.text: Worst airline ever, no snacks on the plane for free, duration time on board is 4 hours and 30 minutes and no body gave as water to drink for free
reviews.author: Afnan E

reviews.title: Fake low cost airline
reviews.text: Check in attendant is so rude and good at threatening customer if you disagree with her. Add ons are ridiculously expensive which causes the so called low cost fare become an expensive flight. Flight got delayed multiple times and customer service is not helpful. Definitely will not recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: F, D

reviews.title: Worst airline in history
reviews.text: Worst airline, do not waste your time. The price of the tickets are not worth it to some of my experience. They change my seat without consulting me although I paid a premium for it they have lost my luggage for over two weeks with no solution, but to continue to email them. I have been waiting for a phone call from them and have not received any phone calls. Honestly don’t waste your time or money.
reviews.author: Harmeet k

reviews.title: Losing bag after Staff member failed to Tag Bag at check in.
reviews.text: Flair air have failed to find my bag after there staff member "James" at Vancouver Airport failed to apply a bag tag when checking our luggage. After numerous phone calls and emails. There has been no answer and no one willing to forge a solution. I will be boarding a plane on my own money to go and find it myself. The only answer i am getting is to send more emails. The Contents of this bag are priceless including the dress my girlfriend was meant to wear at her twin sisters wedding as a bridesmaid.
reviews.author: Scott

reviews.title: Falsw advertisement as LOW COST alternative.
reviews.text: Airline advertise as cheap alternative however it was actually expensive compared to Air Canada or West Jet. By the end of my trip I spend more than what my siblings who used AirCa ada and Westjet. Paid $117(fare), $55(seat), $77(personal bag charged to carry on) Total cost of my travel was $249. It is too expensive for a low cost airline alternative. Flight was delayed 3X got a meal voucher for $10 is a big joke.
reviews.author: Agnes D

reviews.title: Over price carry on loggage
reviews.text: They overcharged for carry on baggage 75 dollar, first and last timeni used this airline, a rude fly attendan guy. I'll never recommend this airline ever.
reviews.author: Sergio J

reviews.title: DO NOT FLY FLAIR
reviews.text: Flair delayed our flight over 4 hours without notifying us until 2 hours prior to leaving Vancouver. They refused to compensate us because they claimed it had to for with our safety but then a flair representative at YVR advised us to go to their website and file a complaint to receive compensation. So we did this and they REFUSED to give us any sort of compensation even though an employee advised us all on the flight to do this. Horrible airline Horrible staff Horrible call center staff Refused water on flight Then we tried to check in when going back home and the online service was down so they made us pay even more at the airport. What a joke. Hope you go bankrupt Never ever flying flair again in my life. Such a sad pathetic joke of a company and I wonder how ppl can even work for them. What an embarrassment to say you work for flair. Fly any other airline because it will end up being cheaper Flair charges to check in and Baggage even a small carry on is over 50$. DO NOT FLY FLAIR unless you don't care about spending extra money and being treated poorly and having flight delayed with no compensation whatsoever
reviews.author: krisssstini

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: They will get you to book a time and change it on you no matter what. This was the talk by many on the plane we were on. Others were telling us this is common practice for flair. So if you are traveling with children, don't expect to get a flight that accomodates you.
reviews.author: Dave B

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: So thankful to have an airline that can provide an outstanding service for such great price! We have been flying with flair often and always have a great experience. I flew with my entire family today and had a great experience as usual
reviews.author: Candè B

reviews.title: Cancelled flight with no notifcation
reviews.text: Flair cancelled our flight without notifying us, then claimed they had sent us an email in March about cancellation, which was a LIE. Would not give us any food or hotel vouchers because it was 'against policy' as they claimed they notified us, which (AGAIN) they did not. They were not able to provide any information on what the 'email' said nor why the flight was cancelled, simply the option to rebook. The next flight leaving from our airport would have been the following week so this was obviously not an option and Flair did nothing to accommodate us for their mistake. We then made arrangements ourselves to get to Toronto and paid OUR OWN MONEY for transportation and stay despite Flair's mistake. We spent HOURS on hold trying to rebook our flights with agents who were clearly phone-shy and unconfident. We then paid for our seats and to sit together. However, when we boarded the plane (DELAYED), we discovered someone else sitting in our seats as Flair had double booked them. How this is even possible is unclear. My partner and I had to stand in the back with flight attendants who then graciously had find room for us on an already fully-booked flight. Needless to say this experience was a MESS for which Flair took no responsibility. There seem to be multiple issues with the system but seemingly none that involve taking customers' money for flights and seats they have no intention of giving you. We were not offered any compensation for this terrible service whatsoever, despite the many hours spent on the phone with people who for some reason 'could not send us to their supervisor'.
reviews.author: MMM

reviews.title: A BIG disappointment
reviews.text: Thought I'd save money and ended up paying double, worst call center ever, asked at least 10 times to get transferred to a supervisor and was refused. They lie to your face. Please avoid this airline, they will RUIN your vacation/ business trip. NEVER EVER AGAIN!!@!
reviews.author: MR R.

reviews.title: Imagine the perfect flight...
reviews.text: Keep imagining it. For four days. That's how long it took to finally get back to Vancouver, eventually, after over a thousand dollars in extra costs. And forget about a refund. Budget airline? No. Just a bunch of grifters. If you really dislike someone intensely, suggest they fly with these losers. You might never see them again.
reviews.author: Cathy M

reviews.title: Mr.
reviews.text: This is my fourth flight with Fair Airlines. The air fare, even with extras such as checked and carry on baggage, seat selection and priority boarding, was considerably less than competitors. The Boeing 737 Max 8 was new and the interior clean. We left on-time and arrived on time. Flight was uneventful. Made booking online with no problem. Check-in at airport went smoothly, staff were accommodating and efficient. I returned to Winnipeg from Vancouver with Flair. Same good results. Good level of service, good price and on schedule. Will continue to fly domestically with Flair as long as it remains competitive and continues to provide acceptable level of service.
reviews.author: Ron R

reviews.title: Cheap & gets the job done
reviews.text: Round trip between Toronto and Vancouver. For a total around C$180 + C$40 (1 exit row seat), there is nothing to complain. Flight is on time both times, although this largely depends on which route you fly with. The online check-in went smoothly. Don't expect any service or free stuff, you pay for the seatbelt and it takes you from point A to point B. The seats are not the most comfortable to be fair, but the legroom is ample. I highly recommend if you are looking to save some money on flights and doesn't care to much about comfort/service.
reviews.author: Charles Cai

reviews.title: Easy Travel
reviews.text: About 15 family members traveled for my cousin wedding and we had no issues with Flair. Easy flight both ways. No delays and staff was great
reviews.author: Deb D

reviews.title: Absolutely nothing offered to purchase
reviews.text: Took a noon flight home from Nashville. Not only was there no lunch to purchase, we were not even offered a water! Nothing!! I don't know why flight attendants were on this flight. Passengers stored their own carry on in the overhead compartments and removed them at the end of the flight. The attendants did nothing on this flight!
reviews.author: sandy o

reviews.title: Pizza for breakfast?
reviews.text: Took an early morning flight from Toronto to Nashville. I wanted to order the egg breakfast sandwich but was advised they only had pizza available. For breakfast????
reviews.author: sandy o

reviews.title: Love my Flair experiences
reviews.text: This is the fourth time I've flown with Flair, and once again a fantastic trip. We actually left the gate about 10 mins early because the passengers had all boarded, safety briefing done, and crew was ready. I felt comfortable to manage my own check in, lift my own bags, and pack my own snack/water. Therefore, this discount airline is the perfect travel company that I will continue to choose.
reviews.author: Ally M

reviews.title: Horrible - do NOT fly with them
reviews.text: Horrible airline. Thought it would be adventurous to test out a new airline....suppose to have wifi on it, so gave it a try. Terible mistake. Went from LAX to Vancouver in June 2023. No Wifi. Seats don't recline. Have to pay for even water. Will never fly again.
reviews.author: tsaoh

reviews.title: Cancelled without warning
reviews.text: When my wife and I arrived 3 hours before our flight because the online checkin didn’t work and we phone to see if everything was ok they said everything if fine just show up early. I had my ticket in the app showing and the agents had no idea what flight it was. Eventually they cancelled the flight. They said that we could take a flight 5 days later. I had to book a flight home at my own expense and was refunded with $250 credit each. This did not cover the last minute 1 way flight. Everything was within Flair’s control as they stated and they felt no obligation to maintain their end of the contract to get us home. I highly recommend against booking a flight on this airline and as the saying goes, you get what you pay for. Be ready to not take the flight on time or at all and also be ready to make alternate arrangements on the spot. Because they cancelled the flight my credit card insurance doesn’t cover it either because it wasn’t a flight delay.
reviews.author: William W

reviews.title: Worst airline in Canada
reviews.text: I really hope the whole fleet is seized. Worst customer service ever. Gate agents shouldn’t be talking to people.
reviews.author: Mike M

reviews.title: Worst service ever
reviews.text: This Is the second time this year they cancel or delayed the flight with no warning, the worst customer service. Please don’t waste your time and money.
reviews.author: Emiliano R

reviews.title: Too bad there isn't zero stars
reviews.text: I guess the nicest way to say this is "you get what you pay for". Zero customer service. Fly aother airline, it will cost you the same in the end.
reviews.author: vancouverhockeymom

reviews.title: Wrost service
reviews.text: The plane was almost 4 hours delayed and they didn’t give you a food voucher, or any compensation for the delay.
reviews.author: RISHIR K

reviews.title: Everything Went Well
reviews.text: My spouse and I planned a quick trip to Vancouver for a concert at Rogers Arena. Both flights (to and from) were on time and everything ran smoothly. We checked in online 24 hours before our flight and boarding passes were emailed to us. We simply added the boarding passes to our Apple wallet. We have no complaints and would fly with Flair again.
reviews.author: Shaun M

reviews.title: Do not Interact with their Team member named - Harnoor kaur - Based at Abbotsford Airport
reviews.text: Flair airlines allowed me to travel from Yyc to Abbotsford but the staff at Abbotsford airport - Ms. Harnoor Kaur did not let me fly back with the same documents which I presented flying to Abbotsford 2 days back. the answer she gave was - I don't feel like its legit and when she was asked to give a logic and proper answer she defending by saying company policy and she won't entertain any questions. she was is some kind of I AM THE BOSS attitude and made me miss my flight. At flairs there is not responsible staff who will take ownership to resolve an issue. the employees like Abbotsford airport team are even the worse. I would rather pay $200 extra for a west jet or any other flight who at least hires an employee who has " TO SERVE " ATTITUDE. It was my first and the last time with this airlines. uber take much more ownership then flairs. I doubt that management team even bother to read the comments and try to improve. big big booooo to the staff at Abbotsford airport. You guys should not be allowed to deal with customers but might be just might be good at hauling loads on ur backs nothing more then this !!
reviews.author: Msrattan

reviews.title: worst airline experience
reviews.text: return flight back home was the worst. flair airlines is by far the worst airline i have ever used. not only do they charge you for selecting your seat but they purposely seat you away from the person you have booked a trip with. after paying the additional fee we still end up not sitting together as they screwed up the sitting chart for not just us but a few others as well. they also charged $60 for a carry-on! on top of all this the flight was delayed 2 hrs. yes i get it flair is a discount airline but in what right mind do you charge a person additional for wanting them to sit next to there OWN FAMILY. what have we come too that you have to stupid amount of money for a carry-on?!? luckily we got a refund from the additional costs as we complained the following day but either way the damage is done i will never fly flair again.
reviews.author: bro12345

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Only issues were Invisible Disability Lanyard not recognized so had to INSIST on early boarding after standing at side for several minutes at Toronto, even though nobody was spoken to about it at all. Wheelchair Assistance not readily available although requested electronically and I also phoned. In Saint John they didn't seem to know at Flair desk how to get a wheelchair. Flights at both ends were on time! Staff were amazing - especially Eric who was inflight director on return was very entertaining and I never even noticed we took off. Young female attendant had no issue situating my personal bag. I would definitely fly Flair again!!!
reviews.author: Elaine A

reviews.title: First and last time on Flair Air
reviews.text: Wow. Flight attendant greet with a scowl. Paid for priority and had no room for my carryon in the overheads. Basically told “tough sh@t” by the flight attendants and told to “find a place”. I was seated in the first row!!! I guess you get what you pay for…. Will NOT see me again.
reviews.author: Beach Man

reviews.title: Joke of an airline
reviews.text: I booked a flight with Flair, checked in the night before and showed up to the airport to find out that there is no flight. When talking to the customer service representative (Reigis) he said they changed the flight "for my safety due to unscheduled maintenance". He further proceeded to let me know that it was actually cancelled a month and a half before, but they never sent me any notice. What kind of unscheduled maintenance is scheduled a month and a half before? Sounds like a BS excuse to tell me its "for my safety". Next I asked to speak to his manager about this which he put me on hold for several minutes to come back and say his manager outright refuses to speak to me. I clarified this multiple times to make sure it was clear that he was telling me his manager refuses to talk to me with. Every time he said yes his manager will not speak to me. I then asked him to put this in an email to me at which point he started claiming it was a miscommunication and that his manager will actually talk to me. I spoke with Chris, his manager who repeated the same lies about my safety and when I questioned him on the legitimacy of unscheduled maintenance scheduled a month and a half out, he had no response and kept diverting the conversation. There was no effort to resolve this and get me onto a different flight which works for me, just consistent roadblocks. Will never travel with Flair again and would encourage everyone to think twice about the low prices. Not worth it!
reviews.author: Brendan G

reviews.title: Amazing human customer service - Life saving
reviews.text: I called because we had to cancel our family trip due to serious health conditions from one member. In less than 10 minutes, they kindly offered a credit good for 2 years, and offered empathy for my situation. I was ready to spend more than 1 hour on the phone, having to argue for a chance to get some kind of consolation, and just like that, they helped me. Amazing. Thank you. Thank you.
reviews.author: NelleT

reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: Their website wouldn't let me add bags when I booked my flight . Everytime I tried it kept giving me errors . As soon as I stopped trying to add bags to my flight it went through immediately. They charge double for bags at the airport than online. I ended up checking in online on my way back and was only able to check in for one of my two flights and it cost me 50 dollars to add my bag online . It wouldn't let me check in for my other flight at all so I ended up having to pay them 63 dollars for my bag at the check in. When I complained about the price they said I should have added it when I booked my flight and when I said it wouldn't let me add baggage they said it wasn't their problem . Then they were upset because I didn't have a second debit card to let them try because they couldn't get it to work in their system even though I had just used my card to purchase a drink about 2 minutes before that. The wifi they announced at the beginning of the flight that you could access through their app didn't even work. Had a round trip with them and I wouldn't recommend it
reviews.author: Kitty b

reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text: I had booked 5 months in advance for a flight for 6 am - and even though domestic they wanted me there 3 hours prior to the flight (that would be 3 am). Flair changed their schedule and i only found out by checking in - had not I logged in the day before I would have shown up at the airport at 3 am for a flight that was no more. They charge you for extra legroom seats but really they are ll the same - except if you are in the Front Row. Their entertainment and onboard service is - pathetic - $3.29 for a Nescafe? No, thank you. Entertainment? none - Their customer service is robotic, cold, and absolutely unsupported.
reviews.author: Polina Shad
